communication_style.decision_style: Prefers a short ranked set of workable options and asks targeted follow-up questions when a hotel claim or flight constraint is unclear.
communication_style.request_pattern: Usually supplies dates and fixed commitments first, then asks for a compact comparison with the important tradeoffs made explicit.

habit_interactions: For work flights, nonstop routing and a later return departure protect schedule reliability and usable time; Delta and a window seat help distinguish otherwise comparable options but do not override the itinerary.
For the annual coastal trip, beach walkability and the applicable upscale or resort rating floor work together as the main hotel screen.
The queen-bed default applies to shared personal hotel rooms, including the coastal vacation, while explicit room arrangements still control any particular booking.

habits.boundary_condition: Treat this as a preference rather than an absolute requirement unless the user explicitly says no layovers for the current trip.
habits.condition: When searching for outbound or return flights, prioritize nonstop options.
habits.default_action: Search for and present a nonstop itinerary first.
habits.exception_condition: If no suitable nonstop flight is available, a one-stop option may be acceptable, but confirm the tradeoff before booking.
habits.name: Prefer nonstop flights
habits.scope_condition: Recurring domestic museum work trips where fixed access windows make itinerary simplicity valuable.

habits.boundary_condition: Treat the preference as a flexible later-day window ranging from afternoon to after 6:00 p.m., not as a fixed cutoff
habits.condition: When selecting a return flight and multiple departure times are available
habits.default_action: Prioritize return options departing in the afternoon or evening
habits.exception_condition: Use another departure period when the traveler explicitly requests it for the current trip or no later-day option is workable
habits.name: Prefer later-day return flights
habits.scope_condition: Return legs from museum work trips when the final day's duties end early enough to allow a later departure.

habits.boundary_condition: This is a soft preference: the evidence supports Delta as a favored option, not as the only acceptable airline or an always-first choice over every other preferred carrier.
habits.condition: When choosing among flight carriers and Delta is available while also satisfying the trip's schedule, route, price, and stop constraints.
habits.default_action: Search for or present Delta options as part of the preferred carrier set, and favor Delta when it is otherwise comparable to alternatives.
habits.exception_condition: Use another acceptable carrier when Delta is unavailable, materially worse, or does not meet the current trip constraints.
habits.name: Delta as a soft preferred carrier option
habits.preference_value: Delta is a preferred airline to include in the flight shortlist, but not an exclusive carrier requirement.
habits.scope_condition: Commercial flights originating from or returning to her Atlanta home base when multiple carriers satisfy the trip constraints.

habits.boundary_condition: Applies only to seat location. If seat selection is unavailable at booking or is deferred until check-in, note that limitation and try to secure a window seat at the earliest available time.
habits.condition: When booking or selecting seats for flights where a seat location preference can be applied.
habits.default_action: Prefer or request a window seat by default.
habits.exception_condition: Use a different seat only if the user specifies another seat preference, needs a different seating arrangement, or no acceptable window seat is available.
habits.name: prefers_window_seat_on_flights
habits.scope_condition: Seat selection for her recurring solo work flights and occasional personal flights when seat choice is available.

habits.boundary_condition: Apply this per room and do not infer it from the number of travelers or requested rooms.
habits.condition: When selecting a shared hotel room without an explicit request for separate beds.
habits.default_action: Prefer a room with a queen-size bed; a king-size bed may be accepted when offered as a larger alternative.
habits.exception_condition: Honor explicit twin-bed, separate-bed, or other room-specific sleeping arrangements instead.
habits.name: queen_bed_for_shared_hotel_room
habits.preference_value: Prefer a queen-size bed for a shared hotel room when no separate-bed arrangement is requested.
habits.scope_condition: Personal trips where Avery and her wife book one shared hotel room and have not requested separate beds.

habits.boundary_condition: Treat walking distance as the reusable threshold; use a stricter walk-time limit only when the current request explicitly supplies one
habits.condition: When searching for a hotel in a coastal or beach-oriented area
habits.default_action: Prioritize properties on the beach or close enough to walk while also filtering to the trip's stated budget
habits.exception_condition: Do not apply this preference to non-coastal trips or when the current trip names a different location priority
habits.name: Prefer beach-proximate hotels
habits.preference_value: A hotel on or near the beach, ideally within walking distance
habits.scope_condition: The couple's recurring beach-oriented vacation when comparing hotels within the stated trip budget.

habits.boundary_condition: Use a 3.5 minimum when the search is explicitly budget-focused. Apply either threshold only to the rating metric under discussion, and do not conflate hotel class, Google ratings, and customer-review ratings.
habits.condition: When a hotel search calls for a well-rated property and frames the stay as nice, upscale, resort-style, or explicitly budget-focused.
habits.default_action: Filter or prioritize options meeting a 4.0 minimum for nice, upscale, or resort-style searches, and identify the rating source when known.
habits.exception_condition: Follow any newly stated threshold or metric. If no suitable option meets the applicable floor while satisfying more important trip constraints, ask before relaxing it.
habits.name: contextual_hotel_rating_floor
habits.preference_value: Prefer hotels rated at least 4.0 when seeking a nice, upscale, or resort-style stay; for explicitly budget-focused searches, prefer at least 3.5.
habits.scope_condition: Annual coastal leisure searches framed as a nice, upscale, or resort-style stay, and any explicitly budget-focused variant of that search.

longitudinal_plan.travel_tempo: Roughly one work trip per month, with occasional clusters around exhibition openings, several personal visits, and one longer coastal vacation each year.
longitudinal_plan.typical_episode_shape: Most episodes span two to four sessions: establish fixed dates and commitments, compare flights, refine the return leg or seat, and then select lodging. Coastal planning episodes run longer, often five to seven sessions, because destinations, beach access, ratings, and room options are revisited before booking; some later sessions cover changes, verification, or cancellation decisions.

persona.household: Lives with her wife; they share hotel rooms on several family visits and take one coastal vacation most years.
persona.name: Avery Thompson
persona.planning_behavior: She starts with installation dates, museum access hours, or family commitments, then narrows flights by routing and timing before considering carrier and seat details. She chooses practical work lodging quickly, but compares coastal hotels more deliberately for walkability, ratings, and room configuration.
persona.travel_pattern: Avery travels about monthly to oversee exhibition installations, courier handoffs, and lender walkthroughs in major U.S. cities. These trips usually last two to four nights and involve fixed museum access windows, so she values simple flight itineraries and a useful final day. Personal travel includes visits to relatives and a carefully planned annual beach trip with her wife, where hotel location and quality receive more attention than they do on work stays.

travel_contexts.description: Recurring two- to four-night domestic trips tied to fixed installation, courier, or lender schedules.
Family visits and city breaks with her wife, usually in one shared hotel room.
A longer beach-oriented trip planned well ahead, with greater attention to hotel setting and quality.
